about: Rift genres: the other stories that bleed into the Hushlands (see RIFTS.md). Each genre recolours the world by role: every palette key in a role follows the role's colour and keeps its own lightness offset, so shading survives. 'overrides' pins single keys. 'signals' name the real-world signals that open this genre's rifts; 'kind' is shadow (a problem), bright (a gift) or neutral (a place to visit).

genres.name: Neon
genres.mood: Rain on chrome, neon in the puddles, a city that never logs off.

genres.name: Nocturne
genres.genre: Night-city romance (the Call of the Night feeling)
genres.mood: Three in the morning, sodium streetlights, a vending machine humming, and someone lovely saying stay up a little longer.

genres.name: Gothic
genres.mood: Candles in a long hall, portraits that watch, ravens on the gate, and letters nobody answered.

genres.name: Iron
genres.mood: Rivets, smokestacks, klaxons at shift change, and a quota that keeps going up.

genres.name: Void
genres.mood: Stars in the wrong places, stairs that go sideways, and something far too big to look at all at once.

genres.name: Noir
genres.mood: Rain on a window, blinds casting stripes, one red coat in a grey city, and a question nobody's answered.

genres.name: Frontier
genres.mood: Dust on the boardwalk, a wanted poster on every post, and the clock tower creeping toward noon.

genres.name: Titan
genres.mood: Sirens over the bay, a shadow on the horizon the size of a mountain, and a hangar door rolling open.

genres.name: Verdant
genres.mood: Rooftop gardens, wind chimes on turbines, and everyone somehow well rested.

genres.name: Starlight
genres.mood: Ribbons, sparkles, a transformation sequence, and a small star-rabbit who believes in you.

genres.name: Summit
genres.mood: Mist over jade peaks, a bell from the sect hall, and the quiet before a breakthrough.

genres.name: Backhalls
genres.mood: Yellow wallpaper, humming lights, carpet that goes on forever, and every lost thing, filed.

fusions.name: Neon Nocturne
fusions.when: A build or agent failing late at night.
fusions.look: Synthwave rooftops at 3 a.m., glitching vending machines.

fusions.name: Haunted Machine
fusions.when: A failing check nobody has looked at for weeks.
fusions.look: A server crypt, neon candles, ghosts in the stack.

fusions.name: Midnight Manor
fusions.when: Old unanswered things, and you're up late.
fusions.look: A candlelit ballroom at midnight; a vampire collecting unanswered letters.

fusions.name: Chrome and Diesel
fusions.when: Too many crew runs at once, some failing.

fusions.name: Soot and Shadow
fusions.look: A soot-black workhouse of Victorian machines.

fusions.name: Eldritch Case
fusions.when: A vague task that's also a mystery.
fusions.look: A detective case in streets that don't add up.

fusions.name: Starless Moor
fusions.when: A huge, vague task left for weeks.
fusions.look: Wrong stars over a ruined chapel.

fusions.name: Tech Noir
fusions.when: Checks failing for no clear reason.
fusions.look: Rain, holograms, a trench coat, a terminal.

fusions.name: Midnight Showdown
fusions.when: A deadline tomorrow and you're up late.
fusions.look: A moonlit duel at the edge of town.

fusions.name: Titan Western
fusions.look: A giant striding across the desert.

fusions.name: Diesel Mecha
fusions.when: Many crew runs aimed at one big deadline.
fusions.look: The crew's colossus is a riveted walker.

fusions.name: The Haunting Ends
fusions.look: A dark magical transformation, then dawn.

fusions.name: Solar Circuit
fusions.when: A balanced week with tech wins.
fusions.look: Green neon gardens on glass towers.

fusions.name: Moon Cultivation
fusions.when: A night of study before an exam (once is fine).
fusions.look: Meditating on a moonlit peak; the night calls back.
